meta.title: WITT Co., Ltd. | Smart Energy ICT Solutions
meta.description: WITT is a smart energy ICT company providing remote metering, energy data platforms, and public/enterprise systems powered by AI, big data, and OT security.

hero.title: An innovative ICT platform transforming the future of energy
hero.subtitle: Through energy data and AI, WITT builds a safer, cleaner, and more efficient world.

items.title: Our Mission
items.body: Leading digital innovation and efficiency across the energy industry through cutting-edge software development.

items.title: Our Vision
items.body: Growing into a leading software company that drives the global energy ICT solutions market.

items.title: Core Value
items.body: Growing together with our clients as a partner grounded in Innovation, Trust, and Technology.

services.heading: Core Services
services.subtitle: WITT delivers digital innovation through custom development services for public institutions and enterprises.

items.title: User-Centered UI/UX Design
items.body: We design intuitive service experiences centered on the user. Interfaces built for usability and accessibility deliver an optimal experience, with responsive design and cross-platform compatibility.

items.title: Reliable System Development
items.body: We build systems specialized for public institutions with stability and scalability in mind. Robust architecture and standard technologies ensure long-term operation and easy maintenance, prioritizing security and stability.

items.title: Expert Proposals & Planning
items.body: We cover the full process from RFP analysis to proposal writing and presentation support. We accurately capture client needs, propose optimal solutions, and establish systematic project plans and execution strategies.

strengths.title: Remote Metering System Development
strengths.body: We provide IoT-based metering solutions for real-time data collection and management. Automated collection using sensors and communications maximizes efficiency, and cloud-based analytics deliver actionable insights.

strengths.title: Fast Technical Support
strengths.body: We provide rapid technical support and documented responses. Our expert team's systematic support process ensures fast, accurate problem resolution, with continuous communication that puts customer satisfaction first.

strengths.title: Systematic Operation & Maintenance
strengths.body: We maintain system stability and support continuous improvement. Proactive monitoring prevents incidents, while regular updates and performance optimization ensure stable operation and higher user satisfaction.
